name: blender-ai-wiki-web
description: Blender AI Wiki — static Astro site for Cloudflare Workers. SEO + AI/LLM optimized.

scripts.build:full: astro build && npm run agents && npm run index
scripts.verify: npm run verify:seo && npm run verify:consistency
scripts.all: npm run build:full && npm run verify
scripts.deploy: npm run all && npm run preflight && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run all && npm run preflight && wrangler deploy --env preview
